description: This Java class 'SavingsProductToGLAccountMappingHelper' provides abstractions for managing General Ledger (GL) account mappings related to savings products in the Fineract accounting module. It includes methods for saving, merging, updating, and deleting account mappings, as well as handling payment channels and charges specific to savings products.

classes.name: SavingsProductToGLAccountMappingHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing GL account mappings for savings products, including saving, merging, updating, and deleting account mappings, as well as handling payment channels and charges.

methods.name: saveSavingsToAssetAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping of a savings product to an asset GL account.

methods.name: saveSavingsToIncomeAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping of a savings product to an income GL account.

methods.name: saveSavingsToExpenseAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping of a savings product to an expense GL account.

methods.name: saveSavingsToLiabilityAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping of a savings product to a liability GL account.

methods.name: mergeSavingsToAssetAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the asset account mapping for a savings product.

methods.name: mergeSavingsToIncomeAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the income account mapping for a savings product.

methods.name: mergeSavingsToExpenseAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the expense account mapping for a savings product.

methods.name: mergeSavingsToLiabilityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the liability account mapping for a savings product.

methods.name: createOrmergeSavingsToLiabilityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Creates or merges changes to the liability account mapping for a savings product.

methods.name: savePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Saves payment channel to fund source mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: updatePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Updates payment channel to fund source mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: saveChargesToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Saves charges (fees and penalties) to income account mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: updateChargesToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates charges (fees and penalties) to income account mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: populateChangesForNewSavingsProductToGLAccountMappingCreation
methods.description: Populates change set for creating new savings product GL account mappings based on accounting rule type.

methods.name: handleChangesToSavingsProductToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Handles and applies changes to savings product GL account mappings based on accounting rule type.

methods.name: deleteSavingsProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Deletes GL account mappings for a specific savings product.
